sentence: This project studies how a regulator of gene activity works in hepatic stellate cells to drive fibrosis in the liver.
This project tries to make gene editing work better in mouse strains that are hard to engineer, by boosting ovulation and editing zygotes.
This project builds machine learning models that measure biological age more accurately compared with chronological age.
This project builds a technique that detects T cells that conventional techniques cannot detect, then uses it to study T cell biology.
This project tests whether evacetrapib helps faulty forms of a potassium ion channel protein reach the cell surface in Long QT Syndrome.
This project builds machine learning tools that compare organoids with brains to see how genes are regulated during brain development.
This project studies the neural circuits that wake us in response to sounds, and tests whether noise exposure impairs them.
This project studies how genes linked to coronary artery disease change smooth muscle cells and affect nearby endothelial cells.
This project tries to find out why small cell lung cancer stops responding to chemotherapy, by studying a pathway found in screens.
This project studies how fatty acid oxidation affects alveolar epithelial stem cells and protection against lung fibrosis.
This project builds a technology that changes proteins in human cells at large scale, and uses it to study G protein-coupled receptors in immune cells.
This project studies whether infusions of T cells that target a virus are safe and restore immunity in patients after bone marrow transplant.
This project studies proteomic, metabolomic and cytokine changes in Down Syndrome Regression Disorder to find the neuroinflammatory causes.
This project tests whether a digital program with glucose monitoring and peer coaching helps adults who do not use insulin manage diabetes.
This project studies how inflammation called synovitis affects pain, progression and treatment in knee osteoarthritis.
This project tests a therapy made from natural killer cells grown from induced pluripotent stem cells to treat acute myelogenous leukemia.
This project collects and shares human tissue and offers pathology services for cancer research.
This project builds deep learning models that predict radiation dose to tumor and healthy tissue in radiotherapy for metastatic castration resistant prostate cancers.
This project uses bioinformatics methods to study the risk of cardiovascular disease in people with rheumatoid arthritis.
This project tests an intervention that targets emotion dysregulation to reduce suicide in people with psychotic disorders.
